basic_info.description: Perfectly positioned where Nob Hill meets Russian Hill, this stylish contemporary condo offers the ideal blend of comfort, convenience, and investment appeal. Located in an attractive boutique building, it's an exceptional opportunity for first-time buyers or savvy investors seeking a move-in ready, rent-control-exempt property. The thoughtfully designed layout features an open living and dining area adjoining a sleek modern kitchen--perfect for everyday living and entertaining. Two well-appointed bedrooms include a spacious primary suite with a private ensuite bathroom. A rare private patio offers a quiet outdoor escape with views of the Bay Bridge. Additional highlights include on-site garage parking, private storage, and easy living in a well-established neighborhood. Just minutes to iconic San Francisco attractions, trendy restaurants, and essential conveniences. With a Walk Score of 98, limited housing supply, and strong rent growth in the area, this is a smart buy in an unbeatable A+ location.
